# Atmospheric Dispersion of HPAI

<p class="geoepi-project-summary">Retrospective analysis of atmospheric HPAI transport between poultry facilities.</p>

## Abstract

This GeoEpi project brings together retrospective analysis of atmospheric HPAI transport between poultry facilities. Registered work includes an atmospheric dispersion project, HPAI visualization and analyses, and tools for the Biosecurity Compliance Audit Program.
